test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 10 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Two dimensions of the same dice are given. What letter will be on the face opposite to the face having the letter F?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b8929a4f38a0201589bd4632844aca306ca77ce8e7a071ada5f95edb5691e8c4.png]
solution:
Given: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4b30872bd734205ea6a4724b1a7b2e64f8e45bf07343a8a7f2f407806ca72930.png] 

We will write the letters of dice in a clockwise direction starting from B

1st Dice: B - A - C

2ⁿd Dice: B - E - D

By this method, we can say that A is opposite to E and C is opposite to D.

Thus, the letter **B **will be on the face opposite to the face having the letter F.

Hence, the correct answer is '__**option 1**__'.
